content:
Hi everyone,

I wrote a tool called NodeGraph, which can be found here: https://github.com/adamtopaz/nodegraph

It can be used to automatically generate dependency graphs between declarations in a Lean4 project, and to view and interact with them within the infoview (in vscode). The hope is that this tool will be useful to help visualize and keep track of progress in formalization projects, all within vscode itself.

I recorded the following short demo which discusses the main features:
nodegraphdemo.mp4
